name: multi-pattern-match
title: Multi-pattern Match
description: Aho–Corasick matching of thousands of patterns in one pass, for scanning logs and payloads for indicators of compromise.
input_unit: bytes of access-log text searched for 1,000 IOC patterns (domains, IPs, hashes, paths); all overlapping matches collected

usage.python:
from kura_rs import multi_pattern_match

matcher = multi_pattern_match.Matcher(iocs)  # all str, or all bytes

# (pattern_id, start, end), overlapping ones included; the GIL is released while searching
for pattern_id, start, end in matcher.find_all(log_line):
    alert(matcher.patterns[pattern_id], start, end)

matcher.find_longest(payload)  # non-overlapping, leftmost-longest
matcher.is_match(payload)      # stops at the first match
matcher.count(payload)         # without building a list
